'''Sendir''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He served as [[Tirgee Benyalle]]'s [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]]. Sendir had been turned by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Uther Kermen]] and he tried to kill Benyalle by [[Knife/Legends|knifing]] her in the back.
